title: Browser Access in LSS: log type and identity field

prose.text: Browser Access has its own LSS log type, distinct from the user activity log.

checks.do: Which LSS source log type a Browser Access question needs, since user activity is a different type.
Whether the identity in a Browser Access record is the SAML NameID, which differs from the user activity record.

lss-source-log-type.statement: The LSS source log type for Browser Access is zpn_http_trans_log, shown as Web Browser, and the Python SDK maps browser_access to it. User activity is a separate source log type, zpn_trans_log.

http-log-and-nameid.statement: The Browser Access log type carries HTTP log information, and its NameID field is the NameID Private Access received in the SAML assertion from the IdP.

quotes: The Log Streaming Service (LSS) can send HTTP log information related to Browser Access to any third-party log analytics tool.
NameID | The NameID received by Private Access in the SAML assertion from the IdP
